tagline: Crumb memory foam that moulds around them, not filling that packs into ridges.
lead: Your dog settles into crumb memory foam that moulds around them, with a cushioned wall to lean on.
value: A crumb memory foam base where many beds just have polyester filling, plus a non-slip base and covers that machine wash at 30°C.
intro: Cherry is a bolster dog bed with a crumb memory foam base, cushioned bolster walls, a non-slip base and zipped covers that machine wash at 30°C. Small, Medium and Large.
points: It moulds around them as they settle, where loose polyester packs down.
A cushioned edge to lean on, for dogs who always sleep against something.
It stays put on wood, laminate and tiles.
Zipped, removable and machine washable at 30°C.
best_for: Small and medium dogs: a first proper bed, a second bed for upstairs, or a replacement for a flattened one.
fit_note: Go by the sleeping area, not the outside: 38 × 27cm Small, 45 × 35cm Medium, 50 × 45cm Large. Measure your dog curled up and size up if between sizes. Not sure? Ask us.
care: Remove the zipped covers and machine wash them at 30°C. Air-dry before refitting. Do not tumble dry, and never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Crumb Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed, Non-Slip | Snoozly
seo_description: Crumb memory foam that moulds around your dog, with cushioned bolster walls and a non-slip base. Covers machine wash at 30°C. For small and medium dogs.
